description: This file defines the 'Language' controller class in the Opencart admin module, specifically handling localisation language operations such as listing, creating, editing, and deleting language records via a web interface. It includes methods for rendering views, processing forms, and managing pagination and sorting of language data.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class for managing localisation language data in the OpenCart admin panel. Provides methods for listing, adding, editing, saving, and deleting language entries, and handles user interface rendering and input processing.
